what_it_is: Azista BST Aerospace is a Bengaluru-based satellite manufacturer formed from the TATA-linked Azista ecosystem, operating a mass-production satellite integration facility and rolling out its first satellite from the factory in 2023. It markets satellite manufacturing, integration and mission-support services for institutional and commercial customers.
india_angle: Azista BST's factory-scale approach (reported ~50,000 sq ft facility) directly targets India's coming private-constellation demand, and its 2023 maiden-satellite rollout was covered by SpaceNews as a marker of Indian satellite industrialisation.
intelligence_assessment: Facility-scale and maiden-satellite milestones are verifiable; customer pipeline and constellation contracts are not yet public. Watch IN-SPACe authorisation listings and launch manifests for Azista BST buses.

faq.a: A Bengaluru satellite manufacturer with a mass-production integration facility that rolled out its first satellite in 2023.
